name: io.github.Kochurin/telegram-channels-mcp
title: Telegram channels
description: Read, search and analyze Telegram channels from your own account, post with preview

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide the tools that publish posts and reply to comments

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_SESSION_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Session file created by `telegram-channels-mcp login`, default ~/.telegram-channels-mcp/session
